tools.name: scan_project_security
tools.description: Scans the current project's source code for security vulnerabilities. This is a static analysis tool that reads local files only.

scan_type.description: Type of security scan to perform on the local project.

file_patterns.description: Glob patterns for files to scan within the project.

tools.name: audit_database_config
tools.description: Audits database configuration files in the current project for security issues like missing RLS, weak auth settings, etc.

db_type.description: Database type to audit. Use 'auto' to detect from project files.

tools.name: check_localhost_headers
tools.description: Checks HTTP security headers on the local development server (localhost only). Requires dev server to be running.

port.description: Local port where the dev server is running.

tools.name: generate_security_report
tools.description: Generates a formatted security report from scan findings.

format.description: Output format for the security report.
